summary: The filing is an 8-K by Adams Street Credit Solutions Fund reporting a routine monthly private placement of Class I shares for ~$4.7M at the May 31, 2026 NAV of $20.22/share, along with a regular June distribution of $0.15/share. The offering is conducted under Regulation D/S and does not involve any change of control, merger, tender, or strategic event. This is a normal periodic capital raise for a closed-end fund, not a special situation.
